reports.name: Troy Guthrie
reports.peak_summary: Projection: depth arm with low risk. The current pitching shape is starter volume over 62.3 IP.
reports.published_report: Troy Guthrie is a control-first right-handed pitcher who pounds the zone and limits free passes at an elite rate—1.7 BB/9 (98th percentile) and 18.5% K-BB% (81st percentile)—but his strikeout stuff is well below average at 8.4 K/9 (27th percentile), a real ceiling constraint at the professional level. The main risk is that his modest velocity and limited swing-and-miss will compress as he moves through the system; MLB-equivalent translation projects his K-BB% to drop to 11.3%, right at league average, while walk rate ticks up to 2.7 BB/9. Small sample (62.3 IP) and A-ball context make confidence in the current form conditional, but the command foundation is genuinely present.
reports.report: The sample covers 62.3 IP in Single-A, so confidence is low. The strike throwing is the reason to keep him on a starter track. The lack of misses leaves little margin when hitters square the ball. The control supports a starter look; the lack of misses keeps the bullpen in play.
